changelog:
Every category page now opens with one quiet line stating how many of its options are on out of the whole, e.g. "1 of 10 on" on System, drawn in the theme accent colour.
The hub and the category pages count the same shared settings catalog, so a page line and the hub area row can never disagree about an area.
The line is information, not a control: pages without a hub area stay untouched, and nothing is written, reordered or re-owned.
message: Dev build v858 - Every category states how many of its options are on
